notes.note: #187 accepted-release record review (branch fix/update-key-pin-187, merged with main 154624a872). install.sh now carries a generated ACCEPTED RELEASE PROGRAM block (packages/shared/src/accepted-release.mjs) plus check_accepted_release/record_accepted_release and a nothing-to-do seed; the installer refuses a public manifest older than the install root's .station-release-accepted.json unless STATION_VERSION + STATION_INSTALL_ALLOW_ROLLBACK=1. This guide owns the new prose: the public-manifest paragraph (guards compare with the active release and the accepted record), roll-forward-only withdrawal, the same-version edge after a launcher rollback, recovery from an unreadable/foreign record (fix owner/permissions, remove, or explicit install) and leftover .tmp staging files. Each was checked against accepted-release.mjs, install.sh and the parity/install tests.
